rows.text: Riya's father, Vikram Malhotra, died on 2022-03-18. Around March 18 each year Riya prefers a lighter schedule (thin out meetings, nothing sprint-like); she lights a diya at home in the evening.

Colleagues: Tom Becker (her manager-level 1:1 on Wednesdays 11:30), Aisha Rahman (engineering, ledger), Olivia Grant (sales/product), Diego Fernandez (design), Mina Park, Tariq Osei. Riya asked on 2026-03-06 about plantar fasciitis (heel inflammation, sharp first steps in morning; most cases settle in 6-12 months with stretching, supportive shoes and load management, often sooner). Her heel was bothering her again on 2026-03-24.

Plantar fasciitis in early 2026 was mild and her left foot is now much better; calf stretches suggested by Marcus worked.

Instant Payouts project (LumenPay): PAY-1421 (AML threshold sign-off) was blocked on legal review and blocked PAY-1403 (per-merchant daily instant cap); legal sign-off meeting was set for 2026-04-16 14:30. PAY-1417 (payout.failed retry policy) was waiting on a decision from Riya.

Instant payout market scan (2026-04-08), in PRD Appendix C: Stripe 1.5% (min $0.50), Square 1.75%, Shopify Payments 1.5%, Helcim has no instant product; net amount received is the most prominent number at confirmation. Design principles: never charge a fee on a failed payout, show net first, explain ineligibility plainly. Real-Time Rail has a phased 2026 launch, so card rails remain the practical path.

The old pricing page lumenpay.example.com/pricing-legacy moved to lumenpay.example.com/pricing. Riya still needs to fix 5 links in: Instant Payouts PRD (Overview, Appendix B), Beta merchant FAQ, Onboarding 2.0 retro, Sales one-pager draft, before beta materials go out.

Decision (2026-04-19, PRD decision log, PAY-1417): payout webhook retries use exponential backoff with a 72-hour retry window (Aisha Rahman's proposal), chosen over a fixed 24-hour window. Owner: Riya Malhotra.

Instant Payouts beta: 40 merchants (mix of retail, food service, trades), 6 weeks. Success bar, all must hold for 2 consecutive weeks: payout success rate >= 99.5% and median payout time < 30 minutes. GA exit: success bar met and no Sev-1 incidents in the final 2 weeks.
